question.problem:
$$
V=\text{Span}\{[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]\},\,B=\{[\begin{aligned}-\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}a \\ b \\ c\end{aligned}]\}
$$

Consider the subspace $V$ and an **orthonormal** basis $B$ of $V,$ given above. Given that $B$ is derived from $V$ using the Gram-Schmidt process, what is the value of $|a|+|b|+|c|?$
question.worked_solution:
First, let's denote

$\,$ ${a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}].$ 

We proceed to find an orthogonal basis using the Gram-Schmidt process, as follows.

**Step 1**: We set ${v}_{1}={a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}].$

**Step 2**: Next, we find ${v}_{2}$, by using the formula

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{2} & ={a}_{2}-\frac{{a}_{2}\cdot {v}_{1}}{{v}_{1}\cdot {v}_{1}}{v}_{1}.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the formula for ${v}_{2}$ in our case gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}_{2} & ={a}_{2}-\frac{(-3)\cdot (-4)+2\cdot 1+4\cdot 1}{(-4)^{2}+{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}}{v}_{1} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2 \\ 4\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we normalize each vector to get an orthonormal basis:

- ${u}_{1}=\frac{{v}_{1}}{‖{v}_{1}‖}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{(-4)^{2}+{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}}}[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-\frac{2\sqrt{2}}{3} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6}\end{aligned}].$

- ${u}_{2}=\frac{{v}_{2}}{‖{v}_{2}‖}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{{1}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{3}^{2}}}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11} \\ \frac{\sqrt{11}}{11} \\ \frac{3\sqrt{11}}{11}\end{aligned}].$

Therefore, $B=\{{u}_{1},{u}_{2}\}=\{[\begin{aligned}\frac{-2\sqrt{2}}{3} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{6}\end{aligned}],[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11} \\ \frac{\sqrt{11}}{11} \\ \frac{3\sqrt{11}}{11}\end{aligned}]\}$ is an orthonormal basis of $V.$

Finally, $a=\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11},$ $b=\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11},$ $c=\frac{3\sqrt{11}}{11}$ and  

$$
|a|+|b|+|c|=|\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11}|+|\frac{\sqrt{11}}{11}|+|\frac{3\sqrt{11}}{11}|=\frac{5\sqrt{11}}{11}.
$$
